items.title: Clean-room NinjaTrader runtime implementation epic
acceptance: Historical implementation epic is represented by the current Glitch main source and the native acceptance items below.
No new work is selected from this umbrella item while the current main source remains authoritative.
evidence: Current source authority is the clean Glitch main worktree at D:/ab/worktrees/glitch-nt-rebuild.
The NinjaTrader source tree last changed at 1859a98, while current main is 2e829e7 after source-pairing and release-plumbing cleanup.
items.notes: Historical implementation detail remains available in Git history; current work is represented by acceptance, release, and GL-AI-1X items.

items.title: Native acceptance of unknown-safe account and risk state
acceptance: Bounded native reinstall, reload, disconnect, and reset fixtures distinguish unavailable state from a real hard-floor breach.
Mixed valid, unknown, and locked account state is proven in fleet UI and aggregation.
No beta or live-readiness claim is made from source or package evidence alone.
items.stop_line: Do not promote until the named native fixtures prove unavailable state is not treated as a risk breach.

items.title: Native acceptance of replication, reload, protection races, and Flatten All
acceptance: A bounded native master fill produces exact follower deltas and protection.
Reload ownership is proven for zero, one, three, and ten subscriptions.
Protective-fill races, manual follower interleave, route removal, and one-click Flatten All end flat and order-free.
items.stop_line: Sim acceptance only; do not promote from source shape, package presence, or short-session results.

items.title: Native acceptance of one durable execution owner per intent
acceptance: A barrier fixture proves duplicate and conflicting requests cannot create more than one execution owner.
Process interruption at each persistence boundary is recoverable.
Restart reconciliation preserves ownership for pending and execution-started intents.
items.stop_line: Localhost and Sim only until execution ownership survives process and native fixtures.

items.title: Native acceptance of pending intent through exact position and protection outcomes
acceptance: Delayed, rejected, partial, late, and protection-failure outcomes remain distinct.
Selected-leg amendments, human partial/full closes, and owned-order cleanup are proven.
Restart and reconnect preserve exact correlation-owned native evidence.
items.stop_line: No unattended, evaluation, or live-readiness claim before bounded native callback fixtures pass.

items.title: Bind control receipts to command content and reconcile interrupted applying state
acceptance: Command receipts are content-bound and reject same-ID different-body conflicts.
Interrupted applying state reconciles deterministically after restart.
Control behavior remains bounded by Glitch-owned validation and receipts.
items.stop_line: No unattended control authority until content-conflict and interrupted-state fixtures pass.

items.title: Export the current Glitch main source with Hermes profile 0.0.2.22
acceptance: The export is built from current Glitch main and the current Hermes profile main at distribution version 0.0.2.22.
The exported AddOn/profile pair has a machine-readable manifest and reproducible hashes.
Profile setup and installation fail closed for incompatible inputs.
The release catalog is updated only after this export exists and is verified.
evidence: Current Hermes profile main is 1b4cc51c1d4e1e460595f8df1805277099edd575 at distribution version 0.0.2.22.
items.notes: The existing download catalog records the last exported AI package; it is not the source authority for the current unexported pair.

items.title: Standard bounded beta promotion
acceptance: Current source is exported and named.
Native stability, replication, protection, restart, and Flatten All acceptance is recorded.
Operator explicitly promotes the artifact.
evidence: Promotion remains deferred until the current source pair is exported and native acceptance evidence is recorded.
items.stop_line: No beta promotion from source or package evidence alone.

items.title: Advanced bounded beta promotion
acceptance: Current Glitch main source and Hermes profile 0.0.2.22 are exported as one named pair.
Native intent ownership, outcome, replication, stability, control, and compatibility acceptance is recorded.
Operator explicitly promotes the artifact pair.
evidence: Promotion remains deferred until export and paired native acceptance are complete.
Profile-side export and acceptance is represented by PROFILE-BETA-01 in the Hermes profile ledger.
items.stop_line: No beta-ready, profitability, unattended-evaluation, or live-capital claim before paired native acceptance.

items.title: Normalize native outcomes for Hermes learning and calibration
acceptance: An append-only outcome record joins decision, fill, snapshot, route, account, trade, and native terminal evidence.
Incomplete and unresolved joins remain distinct from attributable outcomes.
Calibration consumes only complete attributable records and never becomes a deterministic trading gate.
evidence: Current Hermes learning exchange requires attributable completed master outcomes.
items.stop_line: No learning or calibration promotion from incomplete, unresolved, or infrastructure-failure outcomes.

items.title: Expose execution drift and protection coverage diagnostics
acceptance: Read-only diagnostics expose identity, quantity, protection coverage, drift, lifecycle, delay, and attribution state.
Partial, race, rejection, stale, reconnect, and restart states remain explicit.
Serialization is stable for missing and warming states and cannot mutate native state.
evidence: Current Glitch native execution and protection services are the evidence authority.
items.stop_line: Do not infer protected exposure, execution success, or strategy failure from missing or stale diagnostics.

items.title: Add descriptive path and flow measurements to the NT decision packet
acceptance: Descriptive path and flow fields include source, freshness, phase, and completeness context.
Missing, stale, and warming measurements remain uncertainty.
No measurement changes execution behavior by itself.
evidence: Current decision packets lack a stable freshness-labeled path and flow projection.
items.stop_line: Do not introduce deterministic strategy logic to compensate for missing descriptive context.

items.title: Define bounded semantic NT management operations for Hermes
acceptance: A capability matrix records existing, safe, proposed, and deliberately unavailable native management operations.
Any proposed operation defines schema, identity, idempotency, preconditions, failure behavior, and receipts.
Unsafe or unsupported ATM/template behavior remains explicitly unavailable.
evidence: Current gateway supports bounded entry, protection, OCO, stop/target changes, cancellation, and flatten; no distinct trailing or ATM operation is exposed.
items.stop_line: Do not expose a new Hermes operation until native lifecycle and reconciliation invariants are tested.

extensions.canonical_rule: Current source canon is Glitch main plus the current Hermes profile main. Export and download catalog state is separate and does not redefine source canon.
